args.title: Fix CSV parser handling of trailing newlines and CRLF line endings
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Handle Windows line endings (CRLF) and multiple trailing blank lines when parsing CSV files, ensuring trailing carriage returns and empty lines do not cause parsing errors or empty rows.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The CSV parser does not properly handle carriage returns (\r) or multiple trailing blank lines, leading to lingering empty rows or parsing failures on Windows line endings.
